mood.label: Risk-off
basis: 5 of 25 tracked indices rose in their latest session.
VIX closed at 25.46 (+11.13% on the day).
Rule: Risk-on = 65%+ of indices up and VIX not rising; Risk-off = 35% or fewer up, or VIX up 8%+; otherwise Mixed.

headline.technical: Reuters reported Wall Street ended lower ahead of Nvidia results; the S&P 500 closed at 7340.53 (1d -1.03%) with the VIX at 25.46, while Bloomberg reported futures rose after Nvidia's sales forecast topped estimates.
headline.layman: US stocks fell on Tuesday as worries about the AI boom grew. After the close, Nvidia's forecast beat expectations, and Bloomberg said stock futures rose.

global.title: AI doubts weigh on stocks; Nvidia beat lifts futures

status.technical: WSJ reported US stocks finished lower on AI-boom doubts. The Straits Times said the Dow fell 859.71 points, or 1.67%, to 50,748.46. S&P 500 1d -1.03%, Nasdaq Composite 1d -0.74%. VIX closed at 25.46 (1d 11.13%); CNBC said it rose four days in a row.
status.layman: WSJ said US stocks fell because people doubt the AI boom can last. The Dow dropped 1.67%. The VIX, a gauge of market fear, rose for a fourth day in a row, according to CNBC.

consequence.technical: Bloomberg reported futures rose after Nvidia's sales forecast topped estimates, easing AI-trade concerns. Reuters said the AI trade unwind continues even as Nvidia beats. If the beat holds at the open, the recent weakness could ease; if not, the unwind could extend.
consequence.layman: Bloomberg said stock futures rose after Nvidia's forecast beat estimates, which eased AI worries. Reuters said the AI selloff is still going. If the good news holds, stocks may steady. If not, the selloff may go on.

impact.technical: CNBC and Business Standard point to chip stocks: Business Standard said US chipmakers fell 5.3 per cent. CNBC also cited VIX options fear unseen since April. Evidence on wider sector effects is thin in these notes.
impact.layman: Chip companies took the biggest hit: Business Standard said US chipmakers fell 5.3 per cent. CNBC said fear in options markets is at its highest since April. The notes say little about other sectors.

outlook.technical: These are base rates, not predictions. After S&P 500 falls larger than usual, the next day rose 48% of 154 times (median -0.06%); the next 5 days rose 58% of 153 times (median 0.4%).
outlook.layman: These are past patterns, not predictions. After a big drop like this, the S&P 500 rose the next day 48% of the time, about a coin flip, and rose over the next 5 days 58% of the time.

consequence.technical: Bloomberg said the forecast eased AI-trade concerns after a recent bout of weakness. If the guidance holds up, that could steady tech; Reuters said the AI trade unwind continued even as Nvidia beat.
consequence.layman: Bloomberg said Nvidia's forecast eased worries about AI. If it holds, tech shares may steady. Reuters said the AI selloff was still going.
